hebergement.texte: This site is hosted by Vercel Inc., 340 S Lemon Ave #4133, Walnut, CA 91789, United States (vercel.com). Data is stored by Supabase Inc. (supabase.com).

honoraires.texte: Agency fees: {exclusif} incl. VAT of the sale price with an exclusive mandate, {simple} incl. VAT with a simple mandate. Full fee schedule available on request and displayed at the agency.

sources.texte: Sale price statistics come from the "Demandes de valeurs foncières" (DVF) database published by the DGFiP on data.gouv.fr (Licence Ouverte 2.0). Only aggregated statistics are displayed. Rent indicators are ANIL estimates based on data from Groupe SeLoger and leboncoin. Address geocoding uses the IGN Géoplateforme.

propriete.texte: All content on this site (texts, trademarks, logos, structure) is protected. Any unauthorised reproduction is prohibited.

responsable.texte: The controller of the data collected on {marque} is {agent} - {email} - {telephone}.

donnees.texte: When you request a valuation, we collect: your contact details (first name, last name, email, phone), the features of the property described (address, surface area, floor, condition, energy rating…), the interface language, the source of your visit (campaign parameters present in the page address, if any) and the date and proof of your consent. If you click "call me back" in the valuation email, the date of that request is recorded. The calculated valuation and the sales follow-up (status, the advisor's notes) are attached to your request. No IP address is kept.

finalites.texte: This data is used, on the basis of your explicit consent, to: (1) calculate and send you the valuation of your property; (2) contact you about your real estate project. It is never sold to third parties. How the form is used (steps displayed, fields filled in or not, durations) is measured without any identifier or personal data, on the basis of our legitimate interest in improving the service.

destinataires.texte: Data is hosted by Supabase (database, servers located in Ireland) and Vercel (website hosting). Emails are sent by Resend. Data is also transmitted to the customer relationship management (CRM) tool of {agent}. No data is sold or passed on to third parties.

transferts.texte: Vercel and Resend are US companies: data passing through their services is covered by appropriate safeguards (European Commission standard contractual clauses and certification under the EU-US Data Privacy Framework). The database itself is hosted in the European Union.

conservation.texte: Prospect data is kept for {annees} years after the last contact, then automatically anonymised: identity, contact details and property address are erased, and only statistical data with no link to you is kept. Form measurements (with no personal data) are deleted after {moisEvenements} months. Requests to exercise rights and the answers given are archived for {anneesJournal} years.

droits.texte: Under the GDPR, you have the right to access, rectify, erase, restrict, object to and port your data, and the right to give instructions on what happens to it after your death. To exercise it, write to <lien>{email}</lien> from the email address used for your valuation request. We reply within {delai} month; this period may be extended by two months for a complex request, in which case you will be informed. You may also lodge a complaint with the CNIL (cnil.fr), the French data protection authority.

cookies.intro: This site sets no advertising or tracking cookies. Only cookies strictly necessary for the site to work, exempt from consent, are used:

liste.admin: sb-…-auth-token - admin area session, only on the advisor's browser.
liste.suivi: estimmo_sans_suivi - excludes browsers that have used the admin area from the form statistics (1 year).

cookies.outro: Site audience measurement (Vercel Analytics) works without cookies or browser fingerprinting. Should tools requiring consent be added, a banner would let you accept or refuse them before anything is set.
